chat.t: Hey, Fixer.
It's an emergency! An emergency!

o: What was that?

chat.t: Something terrible happened!

o: You have to tell me what's wrong for me to understand.

chat.t: Come to where I am, quickly.

o: Is this a job?
Today is my day off, so my travel fee is doubled.

chat.t: What? Since when do you have days off?

o: It's my day off anyway.
I'm a freelancer, so I can choose my own days off.

chat.t: Fine, I get it. It's urgent, so let's just meet up first.
I knew you were crazy, but...
I didn't think it was this bad.

o: You can't achieve anything without being a little crazy.

chat.t: Hearing you say that is actually a bit scary.

o: I don't want to hear that from someone who wants to shoot the most explicit movie in the world.
Where's the boldness you had when you said you'd dedicate your body to spreading the art of skin to the world?

chat.t: When did I ever go that far?!

o: You didn't? Never mind then.

chat.t: Haah...

lines.t: Streets of Vermont
When I arrived at the meeting spot, I saw Valentina on the phone with someone.
Wait a minute... How can you just pull your investment out like that?!

What you're saying makes no sense!
Where are you right now?!
Hello?
...Ah, damn it!
It seemed like the person Valentina was talking to had hung up on her.
Things not going so well?
What's going on?

Don't you need my help?
I should at least know what the situation is.
If you don't tell me, I'm just going to charge you the travel fee and leave.
Haah... listen.
You know that movie I filmed last time? It got banned from theaters.

The Vermont Ethics Committee got involved.
Those absolute parasites...
Because of that, the scared investors pulled their funding from our movie.

An Ethics... Committee?
What, did something like that actually exist?

Just a bunch of washed-up has-beens who nitpick at works of art.
They don't know the first thing about art...
Anyway, because of them, the panicked investors are scrambling to pull out.

Does this mean I won't even get my travel fee?
I shouldn't have come.

Hey, shut up.
Do you think I knew the investors would do this right before you arrived?
Since we're already here, let's talk for a bit.
Looks like she's out of cigarettes.

...Damn it!
Haah... nothing's going right.
I just wanted to catch my breath...
Living without money is actually pretty manageable once you get used to it.
Shut up. Without money, my creative activity comes to a halt.
Then the studio goes under, and I'll have to sell all my equipment and costumes...
...What? Why are you checking me up and down like a creep?

Oh, since you mentioned costumes?
I was just wondering what color your underwear is today.

Do you want to die?!
Stop playing around and focus! I'm getting to the main point!
Right now, I'm filming what might become the greatest movie of my life.
The most 'sacred' movie of your life?

Don't be sarcastic!
My art isn't something to be dismissed like that.
Of course, the next scene we're shooting is an erotic scene using toys, but...
Well, I figured as much.
Predictable as always.
Anyway! There's a problem.
First, I don't know what kind of toy would fit the scene.
Second, our budget is so tight we can't afford any expensive toys.

Just solve these two problems for me.
You're a fixer, so this should be a piece of cake, right?
A piece of cake. But...
What about my fee?
If you help me, I'll give you whatever you want.
...Stop looking at me like that, it's really annoying.
I'll even let you tour the set for free, so put some effort into it.
I'm pretty confident in my physical stamina... as an actor.
Hmm... Someone like you might actually make a decent actor, but unfortunately, casting is already closed.
Then let me meet the cast.
I'm a bit uneasy since I have no idea what you'll do.

Fine.
But lay a finger on the actors, and you're dead.

And credit me as a co-producer.
As a producer, I expect a share of the profits.
I was wondering when you'd bring up money... Fine.
But you have to make sure you solve the problem.

Don't worry.
I actually know just the place, but you have to come with me.
Where does all that confidence come from...

Well, whatever.
So, we're in the same boat now, right?
Just keep your promise.

Cocky bastard...
By the way, what is this "good place" you mentioned?
As for where that is...
...What?!

chat.t: Hey, are you awake?
I'll go to that place you mentioned, but I still have a bad feeling about this.

o: Stop overthinking and just do as I say.

chat.t: Getting cocky just because you're not right in front of me, huh?
If it weren't for the movie...

o: If it weren't for the movie, then what?
Want me to go on strike?

chat.t: Ugh, fine, I get it.
Sigh... How did I end up in this mess...
Phew, today was a seriously dynamic day.
I hope I never have to go through a day like this again.
Is this what your everyday life is like?

o: Isn't it fun?

chat.t: You really are crazy.

o: I don't want to hear that from someone who wants to shoot the most explicit movie in the world.
Sacrificing your own body to bring the art of nudity to the world.

chat.t: We already talked about that last time!!!

o: Last time I said "skin-colored." This time I wrote "nudity."

chat.t: It's the same thing!!
Keep this up and I will seriously kill you.

o: Would you really be fine without me?

chat.t: ...Dammit.

lines.t: Vermont Street
Hey. Over here!

Do you want to die?
I've been waiting forever.

Are you nervous?
I arrived right on time.
...Who wouldn't be in this situation?
I bet you'd actually be good at it once you start.

Don't make me laugh.
Do you think I'm like you?!
I'm a film director, not a thief.

It's not stealing.
Besides, is it really stealing if you're just stealing something that's already been stolen?
Why do you have to make it sound so confusing?!
You want to finish the movie, don't you?

...Sigh.
Fine, just lead the way.
If something goes wrong, you're taking responsibility, got it?
Nothing's going to go wrong, so quiet down now.

Tch!
Fine.
Vermont Outskirts Forest Path
Flurry Village
I'd only heard rumors that a place like this existed.
They say there are folks who "gather" underwear in Humanitas.
Though I heard they "gather" other things in Vermont...
But why on earth do they "gather" stuff like that?

I don't know why either.
Apparently they copy Harmonix devotees and even do cosplay.
And since I heard rumors that they've stolen various items from Celestial priests, they might have something useful.
Good grief...

Alright, keep quiet from here on.
No matter how stupid they are, it'll be trouble if we get caught.

After stealthily slipping past the wandering Flurries,
we raided their warehouse.

Th-There's more stuff here than I thought...
A pillory, chains, binding tools, whips...
I found so many useful things while rummaging around that I ended up grabbing a ton...

You took way too much.
What are we going to do if we get caught?

We'll cross that bridge when we get to it.
By the way...

Ugh, it's so heavy.
Hey! Are you really going to make me carry all of this alone? Help me out here!
My hands are full too, you know.

You're carrying the light stuff...
You shameless bastard.
Who are you-plu?
I've never seen you guys before-plu.
They're thieves-plu!!
Catch them and tie them up-plu!!

Hey.
Are you sure we're okay?
Does this look okay to you? We have to fight.
Pant, pant...

Hey, why aren't you fighting?!
I had to beat them all up by myself!

Sorry.
My hands were full.
Are you trying to piss me off...?
...Come to think of it.
Sigh... Since they're Celestial items, I still feel a bit uneasy about this.
Don't worry about it too much.
You were just doing what I told you to.
...Are you being serious?
Think whatever you want.
What's going on? What happened?
Oh, come to think of it...
The Celestials said they were going to subjugate the Flurries who stole their things soon.
That means their devotees will be swarming this place any minute...!!
If we're unlucky, we might get subjected to some horrible <bouten>ritual</bouten> too...
Isn't that actually a good thing?
We need to get out of here right now! Grab the stuff!

...Valentina.
We can't escape carrying all of this stuff.

We have no time.
Just pick the one toy you absolutely need for your movie!

Ugh, I went through all this hell and I can only take one...
It's not fair!
But if I have to choose just one...
...It's this one!

You picked a pretty big one.
It looks too heavy to carry alone.
Ugh, I'll give you a bonus later, so just help me carry it!!

chat.t: Getting the toy is all well and good, but...
I have no idea what kind of scene I should shoot using this pillory.

o: Why are you confused when you were the one who picked it?
Didn't you choose it because you knew how to use it?

chat.t: I've seen it in books and videos, but I've never actually used one myself.
We have things to discuss, so come to the studio first.

o: Hey
Hey.
Are you alive?
Don't be shy.

chat.t: Shut up! Let's talk about it next time.
Right now... I have a lot on my mind.

lines.t: Kinogarten Studio
You're here.
What were you doing up there?
I was hanging the pillory we got last time from the ceiling.
It's great that we got it thanks to you, but...
...Just having it doesn't mean inspiration automatically strikes.
I couldn't sleep a wink because I was planning all night.

Fortunately, we have no shoot scheduled today.
I've got more than enough time to think.

Well, my time isn't "more than enough."
I'm not exactly sitting around with nothing to do.
You were the one who said you wanted to be the co-producer of this movie.
Did you think your job was done after fetching a single pillory?
No wonder you never get any investors if this is how you treat your producers.
I only treat you like this.

Anyway, don't think you're going home until I get some inspiration.
So help me out.
And how exactly is this inspiration supposed to strike?
It just hits you out of nowhere, like <bouten>bam</bouten>.
While eating, showering, lying down, or when you're in the studio like right now.

Are you serious?
How long do you expect me to wait for that?

Just wait a bit.
Now that the pillory is set up, something should come to me soon.
Set up the camera here, too... and done.
Hmm...
An hour later
Hmm...
Hmmmm...
I can't think of anything good at all.
Are you kidding me right now?
...This isn't working.
Valentina glances at the pillory hanging from the ceiling.
Have you ever used something like this before?

No. Why would I?
I wasn't the one who picked it.
Sigh... I need to get some inspiration before we can do anything...
Why are you suddenly taking your clothes off?
Shut up.

My nickname is "the hands-on director."
I can't rest until I've experienced everything firsthand.
It's a good thing you're here right now.
Since you're the biggest pervert I've ever met.
Thanks for the compliment.
Valentina shackles herself into the pillory.
Now that I'm shackled, go ahead and do whatever you want with me...

...Wait, not like that!
Don't actually do anything! I just want you to tell me what you'd do!!
So I can use it as material!
...You gave me permission, right?
...Mmph!
Urgh...!

I told you, didn't I?
It was just for the movie, so don't actually do anything!
You literally asked for it yourself.
Didn't you say you can't rest until you experience everything firsthand?
Ugh... Still, this is too much!
I told you to let me go halfway through!
Would you really have gotten the experience you wanted if I did?
How are you going to express the atmosphere, tension, and pleasure of a shackle scene in your movie without actually experiencing it first?

Shut up! You're just a simple pervert.
What do you know about movies...!

chat.t: Hey.
Don't you have anything to say to me?

o: Say what?

chat.t: Sigh, why do I even expect anything from you?
Do I seriously have to spell it out for you?
I'm talking about what you did to me last time.

o: You were the one who asked me to do that.

chat.t: That's not what I asked for!
Sigh, forget it.
I'll let last time slide for now, so just come to the studio.

o: Isn't today a non-shooting day?

chat.t: Movie production continues even on days without a shoot.
You ran your mouth about movies without even knowing that?
Anyway, hurry up and get over here.
Did you catch a cold?

o: I don't know, but you really need to turn on the heating in your studio.

chat.t: You could just dress warmly, dummy.

o: You could just turn on the heater, idiot.

chat.t: Anyway, see you tomorrow.

lines.t:
Unable to resist Valentina's nagging, I headed to the studio.
Duty calls, after all.
Kinogarten Studio
Do you want to die? Why are you so late?!
Being a movie producer is a grueling job.
Did you think making a movie would be easy?
Sit down here for a second.
Why? What are you plotting this time?
P-Plotting?
Valentina was definitely up to something ridiculous.
Nothing like that. Take a look at this.
A video was playing on Valentina's Quartz screen.
What is this?
A hypnosis app that's popular these days.
Apparently, if you send a certain signal to someone using a Quartz, they'll fall into an unconscious state.
And you can control the unconscious person however you want, supposedly.
They say once you wake up from the hypnosis, you completely forget everything you did.

Sigh.
Do you actually believe that?
How do you know it's a lie without even trying it?
Isn't that exactly what you said before?
Are you going to put this in the movie too?
I could use it as material, or it could come in handy during filming.
Just imagine hypnotizing an actor and giving them acting directions.
It would definitely produce some incredible method acting.
Or I could hypnotize the audience to make them praise my movie...
Then why don't you try it on yourself?

I am going to.
Though of course, the one getting hypnotized isn't me...
It's you, bastard.

Besides, you don't believe in hypnosis anyway.
The only way to be sure is if it works on a skeptic.
Sigh... Is this really what you called me over for?
How disappointing...
We have nothing to lose, so shut up and just do as I say, okay?
Just tell me how it felt after you wake up from the hypnosis.
Alright. Setup is complete.
Now... look at the Quartz screen.
As I stared at the hypnosis app screen, Valentina's voice began to fade.
Can you... hear... me?
(Is the hypnosis app... actually...)
Hey. Aren't you going to answer?
Yes.

Whoa, you scared me.
Why are you suddenly using polite speech?
Master...
Huh?

Ha... Hahaha!
This actually works?
Hey.
Strip naked right now and run a lap around the alley.
Yes, Master.
(Rustle, rustle)
Hehehe...
Maybe I should go outside and watch too.
An hour later
This idiot... actually walked around outside naked!
Everyone in this alley must have stared at him.

You absolute pervert!
Put your clothes on before you catch a cold.
...Yes.

Hehehe.
Toying with him is actually so much fun.
Maybe I'll stop here for today...
Valentina closes the hypnosis app.
How do you feel? Do you feel anything?

What the...
I suddenly feel a bit chilly.
Does anything come to mind right now?
No, did something happen?

No, nothing.
As expected, hypnosis apps are total nonsense.
Of course. What did I tell you?
Despite how you look, you're actually pretty clueless.
Tch, don't get cocky.

Just go home for now.
I'll call you again tomorrow.
Achoo!

chat.t: Hey.
Are you feeling any better?

o: Of course.

chat.t: Then get over to the studio quickly.
Because filming starts again tomorrow.
Forget it! Forget it!!

o: Did you get any inspiration?

chat.t: I'll kill you!! I'm gonna kill you!!!

o: You'll hypnotize me again next time, right? I'll look forward to it.
I have no idea what you're saying, so I'll just take that as a yes.

chat.t: Aaaagh!!!

lines.t: When I arrived at the studio, Valentina was turning on the heater.
You're here? How are you feeling?
Why the sudden concern? It doesn't suit you.
I feel perfectly fine.
So prickly.

Have a seat over there.
I have some things to prepare.

What's with you all of a sudden?
Did you eat something bad today?
Uh-uh, you should learn to accept kindness when it's offered.
I got some pretty good inspiration last time.
It's all thanks to you.

What did I even do?
It feels weird getting praised for something I didn't do.

I wonder.
What did you do?
Valentina lightly hummed a tune.
Did something good happen?
There's this friend who made a big mistake with me recently.
And I finally got a chance to get revenge.
But since they're a friend, I should go easy on them.
You're not talking about me, are you?
Wow, you're quick on the uptake.
Ta-da!
Ugh!
Who am I?
My master.
Then what are you?
A slave.
A slave has to listen to their master, right?
Yes, Master.
Take your clothes off first.
Well? Did you get any inspiration now?
H-Huh?
Y-You...!
Since when did the hypnosis wear off?!
Hypnosis?
Like that would actually work on me.
That means...
Running around the alley butt-naked...
And getting done in by me just now because of the hypnosis...
Was all just acting?!
It wasn't even really acting.
Since it's stuff I deal with on a regular basis anyway.
Then all those things I just said...
Oh, I heard every single word of it.
A-Ah!

Die! Just die!
You know too much!
I dodged Valentina's attacks and quickly escaped the studio.
She must be incredibly embarrassed.
